name: JooCart – Powerful eCommerce with OpenCart and WordPress integration
author: softphp

sections.description:
Turn your WordPress into a full-featured online store by integrating OpenCart with JooCart!
Experience the power of OpenCart directly inside WordPress — fast, flexible, and Pro-ready.

JooCart – a powerful WordPress eCommerce plugin. Experience the power of OpenCart within WordPress.

Enhance your WordPress e-commerce experience with JooCart Pro!
🛒 Live Demo: https://demo.soft-php.com/joocart-wp/
🎥 Watch Installation Video:

💡 General Features:

– Compatible with OpenCart 3.0.3.x versions
– Easy installation through the WordPress Plugins menu
– Compatible with most WordPress templates
– Manage OpenCart configuration and users directly from the WordPress admin panel
– OpenCart interface displays natively within WordPress content
– Unlimited categories, products, and manufacturers
– Multi-language support for international customers
– Product reviews and ratings
– Over 20 Payment Gateways Supported
– 8+ Shipping Methods Supported
– Reward point system to increase customer loyalty
– RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) system
– Grid/List product listing options
– Gift voucher system
– Credit system for easier payments
– Reorder system for quick repeat orders
– Wishlist system to boost sales
– Affiliate system for commission-based sales
– Banner Manager for showcasing promotions
– Guest Checkout for a faster shopping experience
– Sales Reports for tracking store performance
– Order editing system for easy adjustments
– Ability to ban customers by IP for added security
– Google Base availability tag for product feeds

JooCart Pro Features:
– Seamless WordPress Integration: Unified front-end and back-end login
– Easy Installation or Connect with Existing OpenCart: One-click installation with built-in OpenCart included, or connect instantly to your existing OpenCart store—whether on the same server or a remote server
– Custom WordPress Widgets: Categories, Shopping Cart, Information & more
– Multilingual Support: Works flawlessly with WordPress language settings
– Flexible OpenCart Extensions: Use OpenCart add-ons as WordPress widgets
– SEO-Optimized: Integrated with WordPress SEO URLs for better visibility
– Smart Navigation: Link products, categories, and information seamlessly
– Shortcode Support: Easily add products to posts with a simple shortcode
– Admin Access Control: Restrict panel access based on user roles
– Flexible Layout Options: Show/hide OpenCart columns, header, footer, and WordPress widgets
– Customizable Design: Modify button, menu, and template colors to match your brand
– Frequent Updates & Dedicated Support: Stay ahead with regular improvements
– And Many More!

Why Choose JooCart Pro?

Whether you’re a small shop or a large marketplace, JooCart Pro gives you everything you need:
– 🔐 Full WordPress + OpenCart user sync
– 🧩 Access to premium OpenCart extensions inside WordPress
– 🛍️ Enhanced product & cart modules with shortcode support
– 🔄 Real-time updates & expert support
– 📈 SEO tools & analytics integration
– 🎯 Optimized performance for high-traffic stores

🎁 See JooCart Pro in action
🚀 Upgrade to JooCart Pro

💼 Need Multivendor Support? Check out JooCart Multivendor
🧩 Extend JooCart even more: JooCart Extensions
🛒 Plus, use standard OpenCart extensions from the OpenCart Marketplace!

Love JooCart?

⭐ If JooCart helped your business, please consider leaving a review on the WordPress plugin page!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the joocart folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure settings from JooCart’s admin panel
  4. Watch this step-by-step installation video:
sections.faq:
Is JooCart compatible with WooCommerce?

No, JooCart is a separate eCommerce solution based on OpenCart

Where can I get support?

Visit our support page: https://www.soft-php.com/

Is there a Pro version available?

Yes! Upgrade to JooCart Pro for additional features like WordPress integration, SEO-optimized navigation, shortcode support, and much more
